description:
Apply distinct background colors to organize a 7-slide Quarterly Business Review presentation.

Open the presentation at '~/Documents/Presentations/QBR_Q3_2024.odp' and apply the following solid fill background colors using Slide Properties:

1. Revenue Section (Slides 2 & 3): Light Green (#C8E6C9)
2. Challenges Section (Slides 4 & 5): Light Yellow (#FFF9C4)
3. Next Steps Section (Slides 6 & 7): Light Blue (#BBDEFB)

Leave Slide 1 (Title) with its original white background. Ensure all text content remains visible and unchanged. Save the presentation when finished.
